neighbours.label: a word-initial 'h' split off by the tokenizer as its own piece (-h|oned, beh|older, -h|itting), versus h-words the tokenizer keeps whole (-hearted, behalf, hitting)
fire: The debate coach praised her well-honed arguments after the final round.
Critics called the documentary a hard-hitting look at the prison system.
As the saying goes, beauty is in the eye of the beholder.
In the old tale the sailor beheld a whale rising from the waves.
Runners who stay well-hydrated recover faster after a race.
The new stadium is a concrete behemoth on the edge of the city.
The local paper ran a hard-hitting story about the river pollution.
Years of practice gave the carpenter well-honed skills with every tool.
quiet: The debate coach praised her half-hearted effort only out of kindness.
Critics called the documentary a self-help video in disguise.
She spoke on behalf of the whole class at the ceremony.
In the old tale the sailor would behold a whale rising from the waves.
Runners who stay hydrated recover faster after a race.
The new stadium is a concrete giant on the edge of the city.
The cold-hearted landlord refused to fix the broken heater.
The boxer kept hitting the heavy bag until his arms gave out.

predictions: fire 0.25-0.7 on '-h' or ' beh' pieces; near misses whose h-word is one token below 0.07
